scripts/start-smto-site.ps1

PowerShell · Tier B

Start the independent public website with PowerShell.

Usage

./scripts/start-smto-site.ps1 [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--reload]

Inputs

SMTO_SITE_PYTHON or .venv/Scripts/python.exe; remaining SMTO_SITE_* settings.

Side effects

Starts only the website child. No interpreter/dependencies are installed.

Cleanup

Ctrl+C is forwarded by the console; propagate the child exit status.

@see src/smto_site/cli.py
